-- Converted: Teradata CREATE MACRO -> Snowflake Scripting stored procedure (LANGUAGE SQL) with EXECUTE AS CALLER; parameter default CURRENT_DATE -> CURRENT_DATE(); p_day referenced as bind variable :P_DAY; sales.account -> SALES."ACCOUNT", sales.daily_balance -> SALES.DAILY_BALANCE.
-- Reason: Snowflake has no macros; procedural logic is ported to Snowflake Scripting, every procedure must declare EXECUTE AS, ACCOUNT is a reserved word and is quoted per the naming map, and the macro's single INSERT is kept unchanged otherwise.
CREATE PROCEDURE SALES.REFRESH_DAILY(P_DAY DATE DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE())
RETURNS NUMBER
LANGUAGE SQL
EXECUTE AS CALLER
AS
$$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO SALES.DAILY_BALANCE (balance_date, account_id, amount)
  SELECT :P_DAY, account_id, balance FROM SALES."ACCOUNT";
  RETURN SQLROWCOUNT;
END;
$$;
